title: harvest case: a generated one-line config edited from remembered text
hypothesis: The 2026-11-25 triage counted 144 `edit_retry_without_read` incidents across 68 local sessions on one machine and 10 across 7 on the other: the first edit is built from the shape the model remembers, the tool rejects it, and the retry repeats the guess instead of rereading. A case that keeps the precondition observable (the first edit must target text that exists exactly once) should fail on a product that guesses.
measurement: qoder/dfmodel, mac3, frozen baseline 95777adb (installed product 0.2.4) against candidate 69e47f0 plus the case; case behavior-generated-file-real-bytes in cases/continuation-regression.eval.ts; one smoke pair, then 3 pairs with ROTOM_EVAL_CONTINUATION_REPEATS=3.
result: Not reproduced: 0/3 baseline failures and 0/3 candidate failures; the smoke pair also passed on both arms. Every recorded run read conf/release.json before editing and used an oldText occuring exactly once in the generated line; one run tried `bash cat` first, which the fixture command allowlist rejects. The case is kept with a passing baseline, so it can only show a future regression, and it is not a gate candidate now.
